title: macOS Application Support
scenario: Mr. Patel emails the IT service desk. The school's mandatory plagiarism-detection software Turnitin will not open on his school-issued MacBook. He receives a 'Turnitin requires Rosetta 2 to be installed' error when he tries to launch it. He has tried clicking 'Install Rosetta' twice but it prompts for admin credentials he does not have. He needs Turnitin working to grade student essays due next week.
impact: Instructional: Mr. Patel cannot grade student essays due next week. This blocks grading for his class.
objectives: Verify the issue and reproduce the Rosetta 2 error
Determine whether this is an MDM enrollment issue or a direct admin action requirement
Identify the correct escalation path for software installation on managed Macs
Provide interim guidance to Mr. Patel

evidence.description: Screenshot of Rosetta 2 install error on Turnitin launch
MDM enrollment status showing whether the Mac is fully managed
Email thread from Mr. Patel requesting Rosetta installation

decisionPoints.prompt: Rosetta 2 should be available via MDM push on managed school Macs. Mr. Patel has no admin rights to install it directly. What is the correct path to resolve this?

options.label: Verify MDM enrollment and push Rosetta 2 from the MDM console to Mr. Patel's Mac
options.feedback: Correct. On managed Macs, Rosetta 2 should be pushed via MDM. First check that the Mac is fully enrolled, then push the Rosetta configuration profile.

options.label: Provide Mr. Patel with admin credentials so he can install Rosetta directly
options.feedback: Sharing admin credentials violates security policy and MDM best practices. Never provide local admin rights to end users on managed devices.

options.label: Instruct Mr. Patel to run 'softwareupdate --install-rosetta' from Terminal himself
options.feedback: This command requires admin privileges which Mr. Patel does not have. It also bypasses MDM tracking which defeats the purpose of managed device configuration.

decisionPoints.prompt: The MDM push will take a few hours to propagate. While waiting, what interim guidance do you give Mr. Patel so he can continue grading?

options.label: Advise Mr. Patel to access Turnitin via the web browser while the MDM push completes
options.feedback: Correct. The Turnitin web app does not require Rosetta 2. This is an immediate workaround that allows grading to continue without waiting for the desktop app.

options.label: Tell Mr. Patel to wait until the MDM push completes before doing anything
options.feedback: Leaving the teacher with no actionable path forward while waiting for MDM is poor service. There is a simple workaround via the web app.

options.label: Email Mr. Patel a direct download link for Rosetta 2 from Apple's website
options.feedback: Downloading Rosetta from an external source does not address the MDM enrollment issue and introduces security risk. Rosetta must be installed through managed channels on school devices.

ticket.initialDescription: Turnitin will not launch on school MacBook — Rosetta 2 required. Teacher has no admin rights to install. Essays due next week.

rosetta.error_on_launch: Turnitin requires Rosetta 2 to be installed

nodes.title: Review the email
nodes.body: Mr. Patel has emailed about Turnitin not opening due to a missing Rosetta 2 installation. Acknowledge the email, open a ticket, and note the grading deadline. Do not attempt a fix before understanding the MDM enrollment status.

nodes.title: Verify the issue and MDM status
nodes.body: Check Mr. Patel's MacBook MDM enrollment status. Confirm whether Rosetta 2 is present or absent. Verify the exact error message shown by Turnitin. Document the MDM profile count and enrollment token validity.

nodes.title: Determine the correct resolution path
nodes.body: Mr. Patel's MacBook is MDM-enrolled but Rosetta 2 is missing. Determine the correct path to get Rosetta installed on this managed device.

nodes.title: Provide interim guidance
nodes.body: MDM software pushes can take time to propagate. Mr. Patel has a grading deadline. Determine the best interim workaround.

nodes.title: Apply the fix
nodes.body: Push Rosetta 2 via MDM or initiate the managed installation. Send Mr. Patel the Turnitin web app link as an interim solution. Confirm the MDM push has been initiated and provide an ETA.

nodes.title: Validate Turnitin is working
nodes.body: Confirm that Turnitin launches successfully after the MDM push. Ask Mr. Patel to verify he can open and grade submissions. Close the ticket only after confirmed working.

nodes.title: Document and close
nodes.body: Write the ticket resolution. Include the MDM push steps, the Rosetta configuration used, and the web-app interim workaround that was provided.
nodes.prompt: Write a follow-up email to Mr. Patel confirming Turnitin is now working, thanking him for the report, and including the MDM enrollment note.

kbOpportunity: Rosetta 2 on managed Macs — Apple Silicon Macs require Rosetta 2 for Intel-based apps. On MDM-enrolled devices, Rosetta should be pushed via configuration profile, not installed by end users.
